openQuestions.question: The documentation states the format is unspecified, so no grammar is recorded; example tokens on the pages are decommissioned examples and were not used or copied.
Whether a lexical contract can be established from any other official source is unresolved.
The user-context OAuth 2.0 access token is sent in the same Authorization: Bearer header but is a different credential (see x:oauth2-user-access-token); the pages give no shape that separates them.
The candidate is established to exist from the pages read; its format (prefix, alphabet, length) is not researched.
